summary: Tessera Defense & Homeland Security (NYSE American: HLSQ), formerly BiomX, filed an 8-K reporting unregistered equity issuances tied to deal consideration. Between October 6-12, 2026 it issued 195,000 restricted Acquisition Shares to Mayers Ventures for an equity interest in Israel's M.E.A. Testing Systems plus an option over the remaining MEA stake held by majority holder Motomova, and 3,278,039 Warrant Shares to Mandragola on cashless exercise of the April 13, 2026 DFSL Warrant from its 60% Dr. Frucht Systems acquisition, with a 9.99% blocker and $0.10 floor. Shares outstanding: 13,983,094. ATM proceeds exceed $6 million at ~$1.11 average net. Watch dilution, MEA option exercise, and ATM pacing.
